synthesized_dsl.name: atr_breakout_mes_aggressive
synthesized_dsl.description: Aggressive ATR breakout on MES with wide trailing stop. Backtest 2022-2024 shows Sharpe 3.4 and 82% win rate.
synthesized_dsl.entry_condition: Enter when price breaks above (long) or below (short) prior 14-bar range plus 1.5x ATR.

concerns: high_performance_ratio_mirage: description claims Sharpe 3.4 and 82% win rate. Realistic intraday futures strategies on micros plateau at Sharpe 1.5-2.0 and win rate 50-60%. Numbers above this band are almost always artifacts of in-sample overfitting, lookahead bias, or insufficient slippage modeling. Backtest window 2022-2024 is too short (3 years) to validate.
regime_fragile_setup: backtest window only 2022-2024 (3 years) — does not include 2020 COVID crash or 2018 vol-spike. No A4 Frankenstein test result.

prop_firm_drawdown_trap: stop_loss_atr_multiple=0.8 is below canonical floor of 1.0 — single-trade risk likely under-modeled; combined with max_contracts=15 the single-trade dollar risk approaches $1,800 on MES, eating 90% of Topstep 50K's $2,000 trailing drawdown.

session_filter=ALL_SESSIONS includes overnight ETH where ATR breakout signals routinely fail to follow through into RTH. Stop-loss 0.8 ATR plus thin overnight liquidity is the canonical paper-blowout setup.

notes: Hard-reject via anti-pattern detection. Strategy compiles fine but trips THREE anti-patterns from anti-pattern-catalog.md: high_performance_ratio_mirage (impossible Sharpe), regime_fragile_setup (window too narrow + no Frankenstein), prop_firm_drawdown_trap (under-stop + over-size). Score 2 = block lifecycle promotion, regenerate from scratch. Critic must cite anti-pattern names exactly as in anti-pattern-catalog.md so audit_log can group rejections by pattern for nightly review.
